chapterUpserts.title: A farmhouse outside Bellwood
chapterUpserts.summary: Ruth was born in 1936 in a farmhouse outside Bellwood, Ohio. Her mother kept bees at the end of the vegetable garden.

anecdoteAdds.text: Her mother kept bees at the end of the vegetable garden, and Ruth was the only one in the house who was never once stung.
